Packaged Electron ignores both the file and these development controls.
 
 Loading runs in the desktop main process before engine startup, after Electron is ready. The file must be a nonempty UTF-8 regular file, at most 64 KiB, containing one whitespace-free credential after trimming surrounding whitespace. A missing default file leaves normal Connection entry available. An explicit missing file, invalid encoding/content or read failure blocks engine startup with a fixed message; raw file/error content is withheld. No directory scanning, provider-configuration import, log/profile credential recovery or provider probe occurs. Loading changes neither connection settings nor task state, and starts no conversion.
